title: NCQA License Verification Standard
content: Organizations must verify primary-source state medical license status for all practicing physicians prior to credentialing decision. Licenses must be active and unencumbered without current suspensions or revocations.

title: NCQA Sanction & Debarment Screening
content: Organizations must screen providers against federal sanction databases including OIG LEIE and SAM.gov. Any active exclusion or debarment requires immediate hold or denial recommendation and committee escalation.

title: NCQA Malpractice and Disciplinary Review
content: Disciplinary actions recorded by state medical boards or NPDB must be evaluated for clinical relevance, severity, and recency. Any active license encumbrance prevents automatic approval.
